title: Race Car
problemStatement: A car starts at position 0 with speed 1. You are given a target position. The car supports two instructions: A (Accelerate): Position increases by current speed, then speed doubles. R (Reverse): Reverse direction. Speed becomes 1 if moving backward, or -1 if moving forward. Return the minimum number of instructions needed to reach the target position.
output: A single integer representing the minimum number of instructions.
